improvements.proposal: Reconcile the existing queue with exact-SHA receipts and served SHA; preserve one implementer and one stand. Existing fixes should reach a checked main milestone before new broad work.
improvements.evidence: 135 commits after retained full integrated green; public source is 175 commits behind assessed main.

improvements.proposal: Separate event decoding, authenticated dispute selection, queued exit planning and event application inside the existing canonical path, using small functions with explicit ownership. Preserve ordered effects and root/recovery vectors.
improvements.evidence: core/entity/tx/j-events.ts is 1840 lines and now also owns pending-proposal exit queuing. This is maintainability evidence, not a measured performance bottleneck.

improvements.proposal: After the fee replacement integration, keep one lifecycle coordinator for durable intent and reconciliation, with EVM fee and TRON expiry decisions at their respective adapter boundaries. Remove repeated batch cloning only where ownership/equivalence is proven; do not introduce a shared reducer across R/E/A.
improvements.evidence: core/runtime/j-submit/j-submit.ts is 773 lines; j-broadcast.ts is 339 lines.

improvements.proposal: Measure current import, reload and command readiness separately. Optimize redundant decode/hash work only after profiling; retain independent observation and reorg-fence assertions.
improvements.evidence: reader.ts calls readCanonicalBlocks before and after receipt collection; the second pass has a correctness role. Old 32.1/20.1-second queue timings predate later unlock changes.

improvements.proposal: Keep React as the wallet and Svelte as the retained static/landing surface. Rust parity remains separate from the TS launch barrier. Avoid a general rewrite while financial integration is unresolved.
improvements.evidence: Three recent cleanup commits already remove 4862 lines net; current Rust explicitly rejects unported lending. Deleting Svelte wholesale is an owner-rejected proposal.
